bind.calculate: if( /data/fill_breast_cancer_form = 'yes', if( /data/bc_total_risk_score >= 6, 'High Risk', if( /data/bc_total_risk_score >= 3, 'Moderate Risk', 'Low Risk')), '')

input.label: Patient's Name
input.hint: Select the patient from your area

input.label: ## Form 1: Basic Health Checkup Please complete your health examination details.
## Section 2: Personal History Please answer each question about your medical history.
## Section 3: Hypertension Screening Please enter your blood pressure readings.
## Section 4: Diabetes Please enter your blood glucose reading.

select1.label: Do you want to fill PHQ-9 form?
select1.hint: Select yes to continue with PHQ-9

input.label: ## Form 2: PHQ-9 Questionnaire Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

select1.label: 1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
4. Feeling tired or having little energy
6. Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
7. Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
8. Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
9. Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

input.label: 0–4 Minimal · 5–9 Mild · 10–14 Moderate · 15–19 Mod. Severe · 20–27 Severe

select1.label: Do you want to fill Breast Cancer Risk Assessment form?
select1.hint: Select yes to continue with Breast Cancer assessment

input.label: ## Form 3: Breast Cancer Risk Assessment This assessment uses key risk factors to estimate your breast cancer risk level.
At what age did you have your first menstrual period (menarche)?

select1.label: Do you experience irregular menstrual periods (e.g., cycles that are often early, late, or unpredictable)?

input.label: If you have given birth, how old were you at the time of your first childbirth?

select1.label: Have you breastfed for more than 2 years in total (including all children)?
Do you have a family history of breast cancer among close relatives (e.g., mother, sister)?
Which ethnic group do you identify with?

input.label: Score < 3: Low Risk · Score 3–5: Moderate Risk · Score ≥ 6: High Risk

select1.label: Do you want to fill Oral Cancer Assessment form?

Alcohol frequency (days per week)
